name: Laingsburg
story: Laingsburg asks us to pause: the devastating flood of 1981 is remembered in the town rather than reduced to a date on the route.
history: Laingsburg Municipality records the great flood of 25 January 1981 and identifies the town’s surviving older buildings.

experience.activity: Visit the Flood Museum and learn about the flood route.
